stem.text: Which statement helps to explain why the two sugar-phosphate chains in a DNA molecule are a constant distance apart?

A.text: Adenine and thymine are held together by the same number of hydrogen bonds as cytosine and guanine.

B.text: Each nucleotide molecule is the same size.

C.text: Each purine base is linked to a pyrimidine base.

D.text: The sugar-phosphate strands of the helix are held together by sulfur bridges.
